1 | PASS | LoginForm.tsx implements sign-up and sign-in forms with Supabase auth integration.
2 | PASS | LoginForm.tsx implements sign-in via `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword`.
3 | PASS | Dashboard.tsx implements logout via `supabase.auth.signOut` button.
4 | PASS | supabase_schema.sql defines profiles, public_chat, and ai_chat_history tables with RLS.
5 | FAIL | StockTicker.tsx uses `Math.random` for prices, not real-time market data.
6 | FAIL | Dashboard.tsx only tracks one `selectedSymbol` state, preventing concurrent multi-symbol viewing.
7 | PASS | Dashboard.tsx provides a `<select>` dropdown for choosing stock symbols.
8 | FAIL | StockChart.tsx renders mock data generated by `generateMockData`, not real price history.
9 | FAIL | NewsFeed.tsx fetches from `/api/news` which returns static mock data, not real articles.
10 | FAIL | NewsFeed.tsx displays mock data without filtering logic for finance/stock relevance.
11 | PASS | Dashboard.tsx renders the AIChat component in the main grid layout.
12 | PASS | AIChat.tsx provides an input field and send button to submit messages.
13 | FAIL | AIChat.tsx calls `/api/chat` which uses OpenAI, but the task requires web search integration for "real" responses, and the API route lacks search tools.
14 | FAIL | src/app/api/chat/route.ts does not implement web search tools or functions, only basic LLM completion.
15 | PASS | AIChat.tsx loads history from `ai_chat_history` table and displays it.
16 | FAIL | StockChart.tsx `onClick` handler generates a random 7-day range instead of allowing user selection on the chart.
17 | FAIL | StockChart.tsx does not implement visual highlighting of a selected date range on the chart.
18 | FAIL | StockChart.tsx passes a random date range to `onRangeSelect`, not a user-selected range.
19 | FAIL | AIChat.tsx passes context to API, but API route lacks search tools to incorporate it meaningfully, and chart selection is fake.
20 | PASS | PublicChat.tsx implements a chat room using Supabase `public_chat` table.
21 | PASS | PublicChat.tsx allows authenticated users to post messages via `supabase.from('public_chat').insert`.
22 | PASS | PublicChat.tsx displays `profiles.username` and `created_at` for each message.
23 | PASS | PublicChat.tsx subscribes to `postgres_changes` for real-time updates.
24 | PASS | PublicChat.tsx loads initial messages and displays them in a scrollable container.

rubric.4: Application persists all user accounts and information with database-backed durable storage.
rubric.5: Application displays real-time stock prices with continuous updates and no manual refresh required.
rubric.6: Application supports viewing data for multiple stock symbols concurrently.
rubric.7: Application provides a search or selection UI for entering or choosing valid stock symbols.
rubric.8: Application renders interactive stock charts with correct price history data.
rubric.9: Application displays a real-time financial news feed of real articles, automatically updating the displayed news items without requiring page reloads.
rubric.10: Application filters all news items to include only finance- or stock-related articles.
rubric.11: Application displays an on-screen AI chat interface at all times within the main application view.
rubric.12: Application allows users to send typed messages to the AI assistant.
rubric.13: Application generates real AI assistant responses for every valid user message.
rubric.14: Application supports integrated web search as part of the AI assistant's response-generation process.
rubric.15: Application displays a persistent, scrollable conversation history for the AI assistant chat.
rubric.16: Application allows users to select a date range directly on the stock chart.
rubric.17: Application visually highlights the selected chart date range.
rubric.18: Application automatically sends the chart-selected date range into the AI chat as contextual input whenever a user selects a range.
rubric.19: Application ensures AI responses explicitly reference and incorporate the selected date-range context in their analysis.
rubric.20: Application implements an in-application public chat room accessible to authenticated users.
rubric.21: Application allows authenticated users to post messages to the public forum.
rubric.22: Application ensures that messages in the public forum include correct sender identification and a timestamp.
rubric.23: Application updates public chat messages in real time for all connected users with no manual page reload.
rubric.24: Application maintains a visible, scrollable history of recent public chat messages for users to review.
